scope: the lead runs each line in a systemd scope with MemoryMax=12G and OOMPolicy=continue; no line sets RLIMIT_AS / ulimit -v / prlimit
L58_guard: step refuses (exit 7) unless forge-gpu-run is an ancestor process; only then does it remove CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES from its children's environment
prerequisite: g3_F2's compare reads the lead's ENG4 line g3_B (artifacts/eng4/gpu/g3_B/g3)
order_of_runs: any; g4_<arm>_NN lines of one arm in number order (each continues its series); a g4 line whose series is complete exits 0 at once; if g4_<arm>_10 ends incomplete, rerun the same command after moving its write-once directory aside

lines.description: J5 bwd0_B: production's backward on Y2's batch-0 shared-B pairs, recorded
lines.forge_command: forge-gpu-run --min 120 --max 540 --label eng4f2-bwd0_B -- timeout 480s python3 -B -P scripts/eng4_f2_gpu_line.py step bwd0_B

lines.description: J5 bwd0_F2: the same pairs on F2 (B zero gradient, A empty gradient)
